uncited: Scale eigenvectors to texture space coordinates.
Let $W$ be texture width and $H$ be texture height.
Calculate forward and backward sample positions for both eigenvectors.
Since eigenvectors lack orientation, advection occurs in both directions.
Average the forward and backward samples for each eigenvector.
Blend the averaged advected noise with the original noise (weighted by $k$) and add the edge contribution (weighted by `edgeBlend`).
